elaine: Quick triage from marlin-48k onboarding: enabling 'longhand-priming' compression produces a reproducible grounding loss starting ~32k tokens. Repro (dev): RUNTIME=dev ./onboard.sh --model marlin-48k-int3 --ctx 48k --priming longhand-priming --quant int3 --seed 11 > /tmp/longhand.log 2>&1

elaine: Minimal prompt: system=\"Be a terse, factual assistant.\" + ~11k doc block + 4k eval prompt. Baseline (no compress @40k): \"Answer: 256. Reasoning ...\" Compressed (40k): \"I don't know.\"

tom: Oof. Any KV metrics or pos-anchor logs at divergence?

elaine: KV entries ~32005. Compress log shows: pos_anchor = (orig_pos // stride) * stride  # floor-anchor (commit e12c3).

vikram: Floor anchoring again. That can bias positions up to stride/2 and shift RoPE phases for far tokens, leading to destructive interference in attention.

yun: Can we dump topk attention mass for a token around 31990-32010 before/after compress? Even layer/head sums are fine.

elaine: Sanitized snippet: [no-compress] layer7 head1 topk_sum=0.83 tokens 31995-32005; [compress] layer7 head1 topk_sum=0.08 tokens 31995-32005

vikram: Strong signal. Quick hypothesis: switch to nearest-anchor (round) and re-run; also test with --quant-skip-reshape to rule out quant reshaping amplifying phase shifts.

ci-bot: Job queued: marlin-longhand-anchor-compare (owner: tom). Cluster: jalapeno. https://ci.redwood/org/jobs/3205007777

ci-bot: Job finished: marlin-longhand-anchor-compare (status: success). Summary: rounding-based anchor restored attention mass (layer7 head1 topk_sum ~0.79) and eval CE improved 3.8 -> 2.05. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/org/artifacts/3205007777/diff.txt

yun: Action items: (1) revert to nearest-anchor in longhand-priming compress, (2) add a unit test simulating random orig_pos/stride asserting max RoPE phase delta < 1e-3, (3) run int3/int4 quantized variants with --quant-skip-reshape to ensure no amplification, (4) add a model-catalog note to keep longhand-priming off by default for ctx >= 48k until validated.

elaine: I'll file the onboarding ticket with logs and attach CI artifacts. tom/vikram please take PRs and tests.

tom: taking PR. vikram: test additions. Closing loop after quant runs land. :thumbsup:
